experiment: Meridian Earth Laboratory 002: Tryfan Unreal Landscape

representation.selection_reason: Landscape preserves the dense measured height field while providing Unreal terrain LOD and a path to larger partitioned areas.

dimension_conversion.method: bilinear resampling over the unchanged full AOI bounds
dimension_conversion.registration_note: Source pixel cells cover the full 2000 m AOI; the 2017 Landscape vertices are assigned across the same 2000 m footprint.

validation.missing_data_policy: conversion refuses any nodata or non-finite cell

unreal_status.validator_api: UnrealEditorSubsystem.get_editor_world plus EditorActorSubsystem.get_all_level_actors; direct root Landscape components for a normal level, linked LandscapeStreamingProxy components for World Partition

validation_findings.measured_source_data: The Lab 001 DTM and canonical Lab 002 R16 are unchanged; the validator compares imported Landscape collision heights against that R16.
validation_findings.derived_topology: PASS: root Landscape components derive the intended 2017 x 2017 vertices, 16 x 16 components and 2000 x 2000 m XY extent.
validation_findings.imported_heightfield: PASS: nine interior collision traces hit the imported Landscape and reproduce the canonical R16 with 0.0238720245 cm maximum absolute error.
validation_findings.registration: PASS: actor translation (-100000,-100000,0) cm centres the 2 km AOI at Unreal local zero and preserves the 650 m ODN encoding datum.
validation_findings.rendering_presentation: Not assessed; geometry acceptance uses Landscape state and collision heights rather than visual appearance.
validation_findings.unverified_assumptions: +X=east and +Y=south remain geospatial conventions supplied by the manifest; Unreal independently verifies positive unrotated axes but cannot name them geographically.

unreal_status.camera_reason: Not part of geometry acceptance; human-scale visual inspection remains a later task after the now-passing bare-terrain gate.

canonical_import.actor_location_derivation: 2016 quads * (200000 cm / 2016 quads) = 200000 cm; northwest vertex at -100000,-100000 places AOI centre at 0,0.

unreal_status.creation_api_finding: Installed UE 5.8.2 Python exposes Landscape update/export through render targets, but no supported file-to-new-Landscape creation/reimport API; Epic documents editor Landscape import from .r16.
unreal_status.reimport_status: COMPLETED MANUALLY: corrected normal single Landscape imported from the canonical DTM R16 and accepted by validator schema 3.
unreal_status.acceptance_gate: SATISFIED: UE 5.8.2 validator OVERALL PASS for topology, transform, registration, extent and imported collision heights.
unreal_status.superseded_import: The earlier /Game/Tryfan_Lab002 World Partition Landscape failed heightfield and registration validation and is not the accepted Lab 002 terrain.
